voiceId.description: xAI voice id (built-in or cloned from console.x.ai voice library). Default: empty (xAI server default).

language.description: BCP-47 language hint passed to xAI TTS. Example: ru-RU, en-US.

sampleRate.description: Output sample rate in Hz. Default: 24000.

bitRate.description: MP3 bit rate (only when codec=mp3). Default: 64000.

codec.description: xAI native output codec. Default: mp3. ffmpeg conversion to Opus happens after for voice notes.

baseUrl.description: xAI API base URL. Default: https://api.x.ai/v1.

authProfileAgent.description: Agent id whose auth-profiles.json holds the xAI OAuth token. Default: main.

apiKey.description: Optional XAI_API_KEY override. If unset, the plugin uses the xAI OAuth profile from the specified agent (preferred for SuperGrok subscribers).

ffmpegPath.description: ffmpeg binary path. Default: 'ffmpeg' (PATH lookup). Required for voice-note Opus conversion.

voiceNoteEncoding.description: How to encode voice-note targets. 'opus' = ffmpeg convert to Opus (native voice bubbles); 'mp3' = ship native MP3 as a file attachment.

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for xAI TTS request. Default: 60000 (long inputs need it).

maxTextLength.description: Max input characters per xAI /v1/tts call. Default 15000 (xAI documented cap, ~3-4 min audio). Text is truncated at sentence/word boundary above this length and a warning is logged.
